openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. All leads place the institution in Lviv; education.ua shows an EDEBO-derived admission offer for the 2026 intake (applications 19 July – 1 August 2026) and osvita.ua marks its page as updated 14.07.2026, which together suggest current operation. Nursing programme: not found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Official website/domain not surfaced in six searches; every lead is an aggregator (osvita.ua, education.ua, uni2study) or an encyclopaedia mention — unusual for an operating HEI and the official domain remains unsettled.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Severe name confusion with the listed state institution Danylo Halytsky Lviv National Medical University (ЛНМУ), which English-language agents also call 'Lviv Medical University' and whose own history begins as 'Львівський державний медичний інститут' (1939); most results for 'Lviv Medical University/Institute' refer to the state university, so any fee, English-medium or recognition claim found under that name must not be attributed to the private ВПНЗ.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Rename from 'Львівський медичний інститут' to 'Львівський медичний університет' and licence/legal-form continuity: no lead found (only uni2study lists 'Lviv Medical Institute, private, established 2004'); founding year, founder and rector unconfirmed.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead shows admission of foreign applicants or English-medium teaching at this institution. A Suspilne article (https://suspilne.media/592639-...) says 'на перший курс Львівського медуніверситету зарахували 10 іноземних студентів ... п'ять тисяч доларів на рік', but the snippet does not identify which Lviv medical university and the article is undated — cannot be attributed.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Programme levels, licence volumes and accreditation status for Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy are not shown in any lead; only field names and one EDEBO-derived 2026 dentistry offer (contract places only, no state-funded places) are visible.
Missing evidence: Official website and domain (no host surfaced; none could be opened from this environment).
Missing evidence: Official English name as used by the institution itself.
Missing evidence: EDEBO registry entry: institution ID, legal form, licensed specialties (222 Medicine, 221 Dentistry, 226 Pharmacy) and licence volumes.

Missing evidence: Documentary evidence of the rename 'Львівський медичний інститут' → 'Львівський медичний університет' (date, founder decision, MES order) and legal-form continuity.
Missing evidence: Founding year (2004 appears only on uni2study), founder and current rector.
Missing evidence: Degree level (Master/Bachelor) of each programme; whether Medicine and Pharmacy have current 2026 intakes (only Dentistry seen on education.ua).
Missing evidence: Any page or policy on admission of foreign applicants, language of instruction (English-medium not evidenced), tuition for foreigners and the international office contact.
Missing evidence: Whether the Suspilne '10 foreign students' report refers to this institution or to the state LNMU.
